title: BugRadar
description: AI-assisted bug tracking and client feedback SaaS. A website widget and extension let QA teams and clients log issues straight into BugRadar, with AI-generated titles, priorities and debugging hints, real-time collaboration, role-based access control and multi-organization support.
imageAlt: BugRadar landing page showing a kanban board of bug reports with captured screenshots

title: CompressByURL
description: Browser-first image compression platform that scans a webpage and compresses all its images in one go, using Web Workers and WebAssembly so files never leave the device. Ships with an MCP server on npm for AI agents and CI image-size budgets.
imageAlt: CompressByURL home page with the image upload and compression settings panel

title: Admin Dashboard
description: Developed a full-stack admin dashboard to manage any e-commerce analytics and stats, including user, product, transactions, geographical stats & data and real-time revenue tracking.
imageAlt: Admin dashboard showing e-commerce analytics with charts, user statistics, and revenue tracking

title: Sticky Docs
description: A react app to create, read, update, delete and save notes in database. It has features like dragging, color categorization, and theme customization.
imageAlt: Sticky Docs note-taking app with draggable cards, color categories, and dark theme

title: DealsTracker
description: A web app to track deals and offers from amazon and flipkart. It has features like price tracking, price drop alerts, and price history. With Implementation of Web Scraping and Cron Jobs.
imageAlt: DealsTracker app showing product price tracking, deal listings, and price history charts

title: RiteBlog app
description: A blog app where users can create, read, update and delete blog posts. It has features like authentication, authorization, and image upload.
imageAlt: RiteBlog blog application with post listing, authentication, and CRUD functionality

title: Memory Game
description: A Memory Game built with React. It has features like timer, score, and switching themes.
